answer: A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in gale, and river reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 189 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dawn account. A farm of 3512 identities would post 1032 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
